snippet.title: Flip-Flop Fury - Official Announcement Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Flip-Flop Fury, an arcade projectile-steering action game developed by Shapeshifter. Players will smack deserving targets with flying footwear across multiple themes and eras. Short, replayable runs with tons of challenges, instant restart, bullet time, unlockable footwear, and juicy, reactive physics. Flip-Flop Fury is coming soon to PC (Steam).
